subject.title: feat(feishu): bot-to-bot conversation support with @mention handling

question: Should Feishu's omitted allowBots default continue admitting bot-authored group messages, or should bot-to-bot traffic require explicit operator opt-in or mentions by default?
rationale: The code path is plausible and well-proven, but this is an upgrade-sensitive channel policy choice that affects live bot traffic and cannot be resolved by static review alone.

options.title: Preserve Current Admission Default
options.body: Keep omitted allowBots accepting bot-authored Feishu events after conflict refresh, relying on self-filtering and botLoopProtection as the upgrade guard.

options.title: Require Explicit Bot Admission
options.body: Change the default so bot-authored traffic is ignored unless operators set allowBots or allowBots="mentions".

options.title: Restrict To Mentioned Bot Turns
options.body: Use allowBots="mentions" as the default posture so bot-authored group events dispatch only when the OpenClaw bot is explicitly mentioned.

recommendation.title: Preserve Current Admission Default
recommendation.body: Keep omitted allowBots accepting bot-authored Feishu events after conflict refresh, relying on self-filtering and botLoopProtection as the upgrade guard.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu channel delivery and mention-path work makes this the strongest available owner signal for the policy choice.
